status.en: 25 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 17% fewer than the week before, most of them in Tigray, Amhara and Addis Ababa.
status.nb: 25 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 17 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Tigray, Amhara og Addis Ababa.

summary.en: Ethiopian drones have attacked Eritrean forces that are supporting Tigrayan rebels, while Eritrean troops have entered Ethiopian territory, prompting both sides to request UN deterrence or intervention. The fighting now spans Tigray, Amhara and the border area, and Ethiopia has warned Eritrea that it will defend itself against the incursions. Both governments accuse each other of provoking a wider war as Tigrayan rebels retreat. The UN chief has expressed grave concern about the renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Etiopiske droner har angrepet eritreiske styrker som støtter tigrayanske opprørere, mens eritreiske tropper har gått inn på etiopisk territorium, og begge sider har bedt FN om avskrekking eller intervensjon. Kampene spenner nå over Tigray, Amhara og grenseområdet, og Etiopia har advart Eritrea om at de vil forsvare seg mot inntrengningene. Begge regjeringer anklager hverandre for å provosere en bredere krig mens tigrayanske opprørere trekker seg tilbake. FNs sjef har uttrykt alvorlig bekymring for den fornyede kampaktiviteten i Nord-Etiopia. Konflikten forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Fano insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
